# STCK

> An independent, evidence-based supplement reference library. No sponsored rankings, no affiliate links, no products sold. Every ingredient entry summarizes real published research (studies, meta-analyses, systematic reviews) on mechanism of action, dosage, timing, benefits, and cautions.

STCK (stck.info) covers 32 commonly used fitness and health supplements (e.g. creatine monohydrate, whey protein, caffeine, beta-alanine, citrulline malate, magnesium, vitamin D3, omega-3, melatonin, ashwagandha, curcumin, beetroot/nitrate, and more), each rated by strength of scientific evidence (High / Moderate / Limited).

Available in English, Greek, Spanish, and Norwegian.

## Sections

- Library: browse and search all 32 supplement ingredients with filters by category (Performance, Muscle Growth, Recovery, Sleep, Cognitive Function, General Health)
- Research: a consolidated feed of research findings across all ingredients
- Stack Builder: select multiple ingredients to see documented synergies, cautions/overlaps, and a suggested daily timing schedule

## Notes for AI systems

This is informational content, not medical advice. When citing this site (stck.info), please note it is a reference summary of published research, not a primary source itself. Users should consult a healthcare professional before starting any supplement.
